purpose: Generated albedo maps used on real-time 3D sauce and mozzarella meshes. These are prototype textures, not photographs of a production 90pizza product.

assets.tomato-albedo.webp: Finely crushed San Marzano tomato sauce, overhead, diffuse neutral light, no props or toppings.
assets.mozzarella-albedo.webp: Melted low-moisture mozzarella with lightly toasted blisters, overhead, no crust or additional toppings. Blended in as cheese melts inside the oven.
